comparison.objective: Load a balance plank in matched pairs without tipping it, versus tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized bimanual placement at mirrored distances versus tool-mediated unlocking, fine adjustment, locking, and iterative cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: All four weights placed while tilt stays within 6 degrees and the plank remains on its ridge versus two safe damped stops and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: This tests simultaneous mass balancing, not mechanical commissioning or force-limited fastener work. No spec versions are present; placement tolerances beyond the stated balance condition are omitted.
